audio_prompts.purpose: Listening model for Week 12 inspiration and design-choice identification using the reusable image A to image D gallery.
audio_prompts.script: Look at image A to image D. Number one: This design is inspired by nature and the ocean. The palette is blue, green, and white. I chose a flowy fabric because it looks like water. The mood is calm and soft. Number two: This look is inspired by the city. The palette is black, gray, and white. I chose a structured jacket because it looks modern and practical. The contrast makes the look bold. Number three: This look is inspired by music. The colors are bright, and the silhouette is loose. I used wide sleeves to show movement. The mood is playful and energetic. Number four: This design is inspired by architecture. The jacket has straight lines and structured shoulders. The palette is neutral. The overall look is elegant and strong.
audio_prompts.speaker_profile: One adult teacher or Fashion Design classroom instructor speaking clearly to beginner learners.
audio_prompts.accent_or_variety: Clear international English suitable for Brazilian A2 learners.
audio_prompts.voice_direction: Warm, clear, and easy to follow, with short pauses after each number and slight emphasis on the inspiration source and key design words.
audio_prompts.suggested_openai_voice_role: Choose an available OpenAI or ChatGPT voice at generation time that sounds like a supportive classroom teacher.
